prompt: There was an ancient maze that was said to grant endless wealth to whoever could successfully escape it. On the first level, he met a mysterious cat that told him the maze had five levels, each testing one’s wisdom and courage. Allen successfully passed the first two levels, but on the third level, he encountered an illusion of himself and lost his way. After an awakening moment, he overcame the illusion and successfully passed the remaining two levels. In the end, Allen discovered that the maze’s exit didn’t lead to wealth but to the key to his family’s hidden secrets.

prompt: In a forgotten, ancient village, all the clocks had stopped, and time seemed to stand still. The villagers were trapped in a perpetual state of idleness. A young clockmaker named Daniel decided to find the cause and repair the clock tower. He discovered that the heart of the tower’s clock had been stolen by a giant mechanical bird, which hid in an underground palace. Daniel ventured deep into the palace, fighting monsters and avoiding traps, and eventually found the bird and repaired it. By fixing the bird’s mechanism, he restored the flow of time in the village. However, Daniel realized that every time he restored time, a certain memory of the village would be lost. In the end, Daniel chose to sacrifice his own memories to restart time, giving the villagers a new beginning.
